description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of the git diff command with regard to the 'diff.suppressBlankEmpty' configuration option. It sets up test cases, verifies the output of 'git diff' under different configuration states, and includes test expectations and utility functions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution and output matching specified expectations.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
